name: swiftui-web-studio
description: Browser-based IDE for writing real Swift/SwiftUI, previewing it live, and exporting an Xcode project.

scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test:visual: vitest run tests/ios27-controls-native.test.ts tests/swiftui-visual-stress.test.ts tests/ios27-native.test.ts tests/ios27-regression.test.ts tests/ios27-export.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
